svg.title: The Pearl Sanctum — An ancient pearl regulator in a submerged shell rotunda
svg.desc: A pearl altar bridges two quiet pools. Service stairs and a rear conduit gallery reach the regulator; the lens approach is ceremonial, with a clear return to the Reliquary.
